beliefs: Each lowercase letter is shifted forward by 2 in the alphabet (a→c, e→g, h→j), wrapping around [E1, E2]
Uppercase letters are shifted forward by 2 as well (HELLO→JELLO) [E1]
Digits, punctuation, and spaces are left unchanged [E1]
The shift is a uniform Caesar +2 on letters regardless of position or vowel/consonant status [E2]
notes: E2 shows every letter shifts by +2, not +1: a→c, e→g, i→k, o→q, u→w, b→d, c→e, d→f, and he→je, ae→ce all confirm a uniform +2 Caesar shift. Updated the shift amount from 1 to 2.
